description: TEMPLATE for the conformance corpus (ADR-0010). Copy to `expected.json` (gitignored) and fill in with your own real saves. Each `expected` fact should be KNOWN TRUTH — cross-checked against an independent oracle (e.g. the reader's export), not against reconstruct's own output. Save bytes live out of repo; point the harness at them with ER_RECONSTRUCT_CORPUS_DIR. Character names/levels are personal save data, so the real manifest is not committed.

cases.oracle: <how each expected fact was independently verified>

_field_notes.graces_set: OPTIONAL. Expected count of Set (discovered) graces. Cross-check against the reader export's events.graces discovered tally. Omit if you have no independent grace oracle for the slot.
_field_notes.bosses_set: OPTIONAL. Expected count of Set (defeated) bosses. Cross-check against the reader export's events.bosses discovered tally, or known progression.
_field_notes.world_pickups_total / dungeon_pickups_to: OPTIONAL exact counts = the reader's machine-checked table sizes (unique getItemFlagIds). Verifies the core's tables loaded fully.
_field_notes.world_pickups_set_atleast / _atmost, dun: OPTIONAL known-truth BOUNDS on the collected count (not exact — pickups have no full-enumeration oracle). Encode the multi-slot differential: floors for a progressed slot, ceilings for an early one. Loose enough to be unarguable, tight enough to catch all-Unknown/all-Clear/all-Set/wrong-family regressions.
_field_notes.flags: OPTIONAL. Targeted per-id known-truth across ALL fact families (grace, boss, world/dungeon pickup). `state` is "Set", "Clear", or "Unknown". Unknown means position unresolvable (e.g. an uncalibrated DLC tile) — distinct from Clear. Pickup anchors: collection is monotonic, so an id collected:true in any earlier export must still be Set.
_field_notes.held_common_count / held_key_count: OPTIONAL exact len() of held_inventory / held_key_items. Cross-check against the reader export's inventory.common_item_count / key_item_count (the save's distinct counts). A mismatch means the GaItem decode dropped or invented a held item.
_field_notes.items: OPTIONAL. Targeted known-truth held items — the inventory analogue of `flags`. Each { category, item_id, quantity } is searched across held_inventory + held_key_items; category is "Weapon"/"Armor"/"Accessory"/"Item"/"Aow". Source them from the reader export (weapons keep their reinforced item_id).
_field_notes.equipment_count: OPTIONAL exact len() of equipment = count of occupied fact-relevant slots in the reader export's equipment block (right/left hand, arrows, bolts, head/chest/arms/legs, talismans). Exclude quick_slots and pouch — they are not equipment facts. 'Unarmed' hand slots carry item_id 110000 and count as occupied.
_field_notes.equipment: OPTIONAL. Targeted per-slot known-truth. Each { slot, item_id, upgrade? } is matched by `slot` ("RightHand1".."RightHand3", "LeftHand1".."LeftHand3", "Arrow1"/"Arrow2", "Bolt1"/"Bolt2", "Head"/"Chest"/"Arms"/"Legs", "Talisman1".."Talisman4"). `item_id` is the equipped item's id (weapons keep the full reinforced value). `upgrade` is OPTIONAL — assert it only for weapons (= item_id % 100); omit for armor/projectiles/talismans (the fact reports 0, but the reader export's upgrade_level for non-weapons is a display artifact).
_field_notes.stats: OPTIONAL. The scalar character sheet. Pin only the fields you have an INDEPENDENT export oracle for — each is checked exactly: the 8 attributes and scadutree_level/spirit_ash_level (reader ExportStats), runes/runes_memory (the export's general block souls/souls_memory), and hp/max_hp/fp/max_fp/stamina/max_stamina (present on newer exports only). base_max_* have no export oracle and are not pinned. Whenever a stats block is present the harness ALSO enforces universal invariants regardless of which fields you pinned: maxes > 0, current <= max, base-max <= max, and runes_memory >= runes. Note level/class_id are identity, not stats.
